title: EDRMS Utilization Report
text: This walkthrough covers the two key views of the E D R M S Utilization Report: Bank-wide Oversight, and Department Insights. We will go through each section of both dashboards and explain what it shows.

title: Bank-wide Oversight: headline cards
text: Bank-wide Oversight answers one question: how far has E D R M S been adopted across A D B? Across the top are four headline cards. Active E D R M S sites, E D R M S users, documents held in E D R M S, and records declared. Each card has a View breakdown link, which opens the figures behind it. The date in the corner shows how current the data is.

title: Sites by department, office, RM and RO
text: The first section ranks the top ten departments, offices, resident missions and regional offices by their number of E D R M S sites. Next to the chart is the full table for every organisational unit. It can be sorted by any column, and exported.

title: Physical counterparts
text: Physical counterparts are declared records that also exist on paper. This section gives the bank-wide total of physical counterparts, the total of records declared, and the share of records that have a paper counterpart. The table breaks the same three measures down by department, office, R M and R O, so units that still rely heavily on paper stand out.

title: Comparison against headcount
text: The comparison section sets E D R M S use against the size of each unit. It plots the approximate headcount provided by R A C beside either documents in E D R M S, or records declared. That shows whether a unit's use of the system is in proportion to the number of people in it, rather than just its raw totals.

title: Records declaration trend
text: The last section tracks records declared over time, on E D R M S compliant sites, by declaration date in Manila time. You can pick a preset, such as the last twelve months or year to date, or set a custom date range, and show the data by month or by year. Bars give the records declared in each period, and the line gives the running total across the range.

title: Department Insights: department profile
text: Department Insights looks at E D R M S use one department at a time. It starts with the department profile. Choose a department, office, R M or R O, and the profile shows its go-live date and its approved site naming convention. Below are five cards: sites, site visitors, documents, records declared, and physical counterparts. Each one opens a breakdown table beneath it.

title: EDRMS sites
text: The E D R M S sites section lists every site for the chosen department, with its site owner and the date it was created. It can be filtered by year or by a custom range, sorted, paged through, and exported. Alongside it, a chart shows sites created over time. Click a year to see its months.

title: Library usage
text: Finally, library usage goes down to the document libraries inside each site. Summary figures give the number of libraries, documents, records declared, physical counterparts and active users. The table then shows each library with its site and those same measures, so you can see which libraries are actually being used for recordkeeping.

title: Live prototype
text: Both dashboards are in the live prototype, where every card and table can be explored. Thank you for watching.
